parsed.title: OFFICIAL ORDER
parsed.body:
If you have 2 Objective Cards,
you may during your Turn:

Choose 1 of the Objective cards and remove
the other one from the game. Then, draw
cards according to the Objective choice track
and move the marker on that Track by 1.

The Mission Task must be fulfilled.
